title: Single-sided extreme conformal prediction — conformalize_EQR_unilat
text: method argument specifies conformalization method used construct (extreme) conformal prediction intervals (PIs). available method options : 'GPD_safeprofile' Recommended choice extreme conformal prediction. Tries method 'GPD_profile' first, falls back 'GPD_boot' former suffers numerical instability. 'GPD_profile' GPD-based extreme conformalization using profile-likelihood CI endpoint extreme score quantile. captures asymetric uncertainty score-quantile best, yielding reliable coverage. might sometimes overcover suffer numerical convergence issues. 'GPD_boot' GPD-based extreme conformalization using nonparametric bootstrap percentile CI endpoint extreme score quantile. 'GPD_delta' GPD-based extreme conformalization using Delta method CI endpoint extreme score quantile. 'Empirical' classical (non-extreme) conformalized quantile regression method, relying empirical quantile nonconformity scores. Yields infinitely wide PIs coverage_proba larger 1-1/(length(y_calibr)+1). 'GPD_profile_naive' naive version 'GPD_profile', without alpha_correction multiple testing. likely undercover, use comparison. 'GPD_max' naive GPD-based approach repeating 'GPD_simple' method range threshold levels, keeping conservative results. likely undercover, use comparison. 'GPD_simple' naive GPD-based extreme conformalization using simple extrapolated score quantile estimate instead CI endpoint. likely undercover, use comparison. 'Hill' (implemented) Extreme conformalization based Hill estimator extreme value analysis. See Pasche et al. (2026), referenced , technical details extreme conformal prediction.
